title: Randomized-base GT transfer, revised STNFS core (LA pad 1.10, exact prices, 0.01 shift, 1001/1000 reserve, line sieve to 2^45.5 with rerun recovery, 99.9% ECM, slack 60): 124.754970069062

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm in proof.md returns the canonical scalar x for uniform T=[x]P0 (infinity included) with success at least 0.39 (modelled lower bound (1-2^-128) x 0.390320 - 2^-48), conditional on the disclosed H1-H5 (with H4u) of source-core.md. It maps the problem to GT by z=e(T,Q0) against a freshly randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b, which gives exactly the uniform (nonidentity base, independent target) input distribution, converts both into the STNFS tower by the explicit charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns ba mod r after checking [ba]P0=T. The core is the recover-Q core of submission e3940d11 with the main-phase revision of REVISION.md: 99.9% per-prime main-phase ECM (403 curves per side), record walk to 2^64 with primes in [2^63, 2^64) charged at 2x, line sieve from 2^11 to 2^45.5 with record walk above and a priced coset-enumerator rerun pass, relation sub-region theta=190/500 sized so the descent's 2^63.97 relations hold at a 1-SE lower bound on the yield (with a collection guard), cofactor slacks (297, 233), relation records routed by direct chunk scatter with a measured end-to-end route at 10.3 instructions per record, ungated recovery (every record re-read), linear algebra fully priced as in our recover-Q 711418d3, line/record kernel prices at their exact logged differential quotients with a 0.01 table-lookup shift (21 instructions per sparse entry with the 11-instruction +-1 loop, unit share >= 0.88 under heuristic H4u; row tail with every reduction mod r compiled loop-free, 2,750 per row; 420 per lone 9-limb reduction; matrix pad 1.10 over the measured non-increasing N/U trend 2^12..2^18, part of H3) with block Wiedemann (19, 4), canonical-work allowance 1.06905 (>= 1 + 2.00 incidence-inclusive SE), descent missing-log inputs 745.9/498.9 with six plan entries re-optimised for that relation input, two-log meter 2^118.9532; its upper-rounded complete ledger is below 2^121.4316 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000) with success at least 0.390320. Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, sampling, verification and output, is at most 10 x (1001/1000) x 2^121.4316 + 2^80/2000 < 2^124.754970069062 G1 reference units (C=2,000); the 1001/1000 is a reserve on the whole core instruction ledger covering sub-half-ulp quoted-decimal residuals (recomputed ledger moves 1.000014x). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Fast run (input {}): recomputes the theta=190/500 region, certified count products, yield and margin, incidence-inclusive work SE and allowance, 99.9% ECM schedules, the LA kernel counts (kernels_asm.b85), the row-tail and reduction prices and the N/U trend behind pad 1.10, linear algebra, exact price ceilings, table shape, shift coverage, sub-ulp residuals, line-hit recovery, success and the full ledger with the declared descent rows, then the G1 conversion and finite bijections. {"descent": true} also reruns the complete descent recurrence, node-counter and repeat terms (about 10 s). {"unit_entries": [k, seed]} measures the H4u unit share at scale 2^k (k <= 15 within the limit). {"source": name} prints a section of kernels_asm.b85 (row_tail.c, la_mac.s, bw_dot.s, measurements12.txt).
